organs.Notes: Female BALB/c nude mice bearing MCF-7 xenografts; complex 23 10 mg/kg i.p. every other day for 30 days, organs collected after treatment. Estrogen support is reported as subcutaneous estrogen (0.15 mg/mL/day); injected volume and mg/kg dose not stated, no dose conversion attempted. Treatment_context=combination records concomitant estrogen support, not a separate tested antitumour partner. Reference auranofin 10 mg/kg i.p. Q2D; fulvestrant 10 mg/kg is another comparator shown. Cohort n conflicts: Methods n=6 per group, Fig.10 legend n=3 and six tumours pictured; histology-specific n not established, Group_size blank. Authors report no significant morphological or structural changes in these tissues; no numerical histology test. Separate immature-rat uterine assay is not merged with this cohort. Source: papers/10.1016_j.phrs.2023.106731.pdf | Methods 2.21/2.23 pp.4-5; Fig.11 p.13; Results 3.12 p.14 Schedule as recorded before 2026-11-19: Q2D for 30 days.
